blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Quezon’s “Sunggod Teh Kamanga” festival bagged Best Cultural Festival at Bukidnon’s Pagdayaw: A Night of Tourism, Culture, and Arts Excellence. Sunggod Teh Kamanga is a vibrant showcase of the Manobo tribe’s traditions and culture, uniting the community to honor and preserve their heritage. READ: Manobo tribe holds 17th ‘Sunggod Teh Kamanga’ in Quezon, Bukidnon Quezon bagged the award during ceremonies held last Friday, September 18, in Malaybalay City, Bukidnon. Annually, the event features traditional tribal activities, rituals, dances, and indigenous games designed to pass down cultural values to younger generations.
